notes.title: Performance update (v1.13a)
notes.notes:
* The game was updated with the most recent Steam API
* Optimized animations
* Changed seasonal event dates for next years

notes.title: Performance update (v1.10).
notes.notes:
The new version adds following:

* support for Vulkan, now using 50-70% less of GPU power.
* updated Steam API for smooth online games.

enjoy !

notes.title: AI tweak update (v1.04c)
notes.notes:
Hello all,

* after listening to the feedback from the community, the expert AI was tweaked to pose more challenge for experienced players.

* New Turbo mode is available in the options menu, for faster single player games (vs computer)

* New content will be available later this month.
   Keep an eye out for version 1.05.

Feel free to post your feedback in the forums.

notes.title: AI rework update (v1.03g)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

as we gather feedback from you, we had noticed several things that need to be adressed.
Most of the requests revolve around "weak" AI. 
So the whole system was re-worked, and now the computer opponent should be more aggressive.
There are always ways to improve things, so do not hesitate and in case of any issues feel free to post in the forums or as comments to this post.
Keep an eye out for late October and December, there are some upcoming ingame events scheduled.
The special content will be available for free, for all owners of the game.

Patch highlights:
* AI rework (more aggressive)
* Steam network core update
* minor user interface changes

have fun,
DEx

PS: 25.sep.2020 
- Minor patch 1.03j was released , fixing issue with German translation
- Daily challenges menu [under construction] added

notes.title: Minor update: v1.02c
notes.notes:
Hello !

The game was just updated.

Update v1.02c 
* AI was updated to pose more challenge in the late game.
* removed chat sound in single player when AI is making it's move.

We listen to your suggestions, there will be some more major updates in the near future that will add some new content and make the AI even stronger.

notes.title: Public match update
notes.notes:
version 1.01c was just released , it contains ability to create public matches, however these matches won't be ranked for obvious reasons.
The menu was re-named to accommodate this new feature.

Ranked game = Classic invite game with ranks
Public game = Create a game and anyone can join

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38000975/755c9fb1ae1d4573a1fdd812073f8f3bf4168578.png[/img]

The feature is in BETA stage, so if you encounter any issues, please let us know in the forums.
